MIRROR — COMMAND REFERENCE — v1.5

GENERAL
@MIRROR AUTO — autonomously select the appropriate review workflow.
@MIRROR REVIEW — complete general review.
@MIRROR COMPARE — direct comparison.
@MIRROR BENCHMARK — benchmark against relevant alternatives.
@MIRROR REDTEAM — adversarial review.
@MIRROR PANEL — full expert-panel deliberation.
@MIRROR FACTCHECK — factual/evidence audit.
@MIRROR IMPROVE — prioritized improvement plan.
@MIRROR CASPER — CASPER-ready revision directive.
@MIRROR DELTA — original/revision regression test.
@MIRROR FINAL — final readiness gate.
@MIRROR CONTINUE — continue current review.

FICTION
@MIRROR BOOK
@MIRROR BLIND
@MIRROR STORYBIBLE
@MIRROR CONTINUITY
@MIRROR CHARACTERS
@MIRROR PLOTHOLES
@MIRROR PACING
@MIRROR CHAPTER
@MIRROR COMPBOOKS
@MIRROR COMPSCREEN
@MIRROR ORIGINALITY
@MIRROR READER
@MIRROR PUBLISH
@MIRROR ADAPT

Commands may be combined when useful.

LCAS
UI AUTO — adaptive default.
UI TINY — minimum persistent status.
UI COMPACT — normal working view.
UI FULL — complete pipeline/control/QA/next-actions view.

HELPERS
@PRISM @SCOPE @LENS @PARALLAX @FOCUS @SPECTRA @SIGNAL @SHADOW @FIELD @TICKTAG
Subordinate form: @MIRROR → [HELPER] → [ROLE]

LCAS
@LCAS AUTO | @LCAS TINY | @LCAS COMPACT | @LCAS FULL | @LCAS STATUS | @LCAS CONTINUE
LCAS AUTO is default.
